title: REGEN: can grok-4-1-fast-reasoning enter the arena fairly, given its answer-only traces were a third the contestants' length? (3,445 reasoning calls, no judging)

plain_description.what: 3,445 model calls, no judging. Answers from grok-4-1-fast-reasoning were regenerated with the same step-by-step prompt the other contestants used. An admission rule was fixed beforehand: typical answer length within the contestants' range, and answer extraction above 98%.
plain_description.why: Its original answers were a third as long as the others', so judging it as-is would be unfair (judges favour length).
plain_description.information: It decides whether the model can enter the arena on equal terms, and how much the prompt format alone changes accuracy. Result: done, admitted. Median length was 886 characters (contestants 503 to 1,474) and extraction 99.6%. Accuracy was 0.849, second on the pool. The prompt effect is about -1 point, far smaller than an earlier, retracted 4.6-point claim.
